name: context-tools
description: ConTeXt SyncTeX PDF preview, equation hover preview, DigestiF language server, Document structure outline, TextMate grammar, and snippets

commands.title: ConTeXt: Reveal Active File in Project View

editor/context.when: editorLangId == context || editorLangId == tex || editorLangId == latex

context.root.description: ConTeXt installation root (Standalone / LMTX tree): the directory that contains tex/ (for example $HOME/context or /opt/context). Binaries live under tex/texmf-<platform>/bin/. Empty = use PATH and infer the install root.

context.contextPath.description: Absolute path to the context executable. Overrides root/PATH when set.

context.mtxrunPath.description: Absolute path to the mtxrun executable. Overrides root/PATH when set.

context.rootFile.description: Main ConTeXt file to compile (workspace-relative or absolute). Empty = auto-detect via % !TEX root, \startcomponent->\product, or the active file.

context.projectManager.defaultExtension.description: File extension for Project Manager scaffolds. v1 writes .tex only.

context.projectManager.usePrefixedNames.description: When true, Project Manager uses denser prefixes (product_*, component_*). Default matches wiki §4/§5 names (env_*/project_* only).

context.projectManager.setRootFileOnCrea.description: When true, after creating a structure set context.rootFile to the compile root (document or product). Does not write % !TEX root into files.

context.projectView.enabled.description: Show the ConTeXt Project TreeView in the ConTeXt activity-bar container.

context.projectView.includeInputs.description: When true, show \input children under products in the Project view.

context.projectView.maxFiles.description: Stop expanding the project graph after this many files; remaining includes are truncated.

context.projectView.refreshDebounceMs.description: Debounce interval (ms) before rescanning the project graph after edits or saves.

context.documentOutline.enabled.description: Show the ConTeXt Document structure TreeView (sectioning outline for the active compile unit).

context.documentOutline.refreshDebounceM.description: Debounce interval (ms) before rescanning Document structure after edits or saves.

context.documentOutline.digestifEnrichme.description: When DigestiF is running, prefer its symbol titles on matching Document structure heads. Has no effect when DigestiF is off; the scan-backed outline still works.

context.build.args.description: Extra arguments appended after --synctex=repeat when building. Prefer context.build.activeModes for --mode; if both set a --mode, activeModes wins and the build path warns.

context.build.modes.description: Catalog of ConTeXt mode names shown in ConTeXt: Select Build Modes. Persisted as a workspace setting when edited via the picker.

context.build.activeModes.description: Currently enabled ConTeXt modes. When non-empty, the build injects --mode=a,b (overriding any --mode in context.build.args). Persisted as a workspace setting via ConTeXt: Select Build Modes.

context.build.onSave.description: When true, save of a ConTeXt/TeX file starts a build. While a build runs, further saves queue one follow-up build (rapid saves coalesce).

context.synctex.enabled.description: Enable SyncTeX forward and backward navigation.

context.viewer.openExistingOnActivate.description: When true, on activation open the root job PDF in the ConTeXt viewer if PDF and sibling SyncTeX already pass the artifact gate (no rebuild). Default false: use ConTeXt: Show PDF or Explorer → Open in ConTeXt PDF Viewer.

context.debugOutput.description: When true, write verbose internal traces (viewer, artifact gate, SyncTeX dumps, project scan timing) to the ConTeXt debug output channel. Build and user-facing messages stay on ConTeXt.

context.digestif.enabled.description: Start the Digestif language server for ConTeXt/TeX completion and hover. Build and SyncTeX keep working if Digestif is missing.

context.digestifPath.description: Absolute path to the Digestif executable. Empty = resolve ~/.luarocks/bin/digestif then digestif on PATH.

context.texAssociation.dontAsk.description: If true, never prompt to associate *.tex with the ConTeXt language for DigestiF. Also set via the prompt's Don't ask again action (workspace state).

context.extensionConflict.dontAsk.description: If true, never warn when other installed extensions contribute language id context or the same ConTeXt file extensions (.mkiv, .mkxl, …). Also set via the warning's Don't show again action (global state).

context.equationPreview.enabled.description: Show a ConTeXt-typeset hover preview when the cursor is on math (\startformula…\stopformula, dollar math, or the active selection).

context.equationPreview.environment.description: ConTeXt preamble inserted before \startTEXpage in the equation preview job (macros, \environment…, fonts, setups). Empty = stock math only. Set as User or Workspace; Workspace overrides User. Not inferred from the Project.

context.equationPreview.format.description: Preferred hover image format. Hover display uses PNG (SVG in Markdown hover is unreliable); svg still builds a vector export for Save SVG.

context.equationPreview.maxWidth.description: Maximum hover preview width in pixels (aspect ratio preserved).

context.equationPreview.maxHeight.description: Maximum hover preview height in pixels (aspect ratio preserved).

context.equationPreview.timeoutMs.description: Timeout (ms) for the temporary context --once equation job.

context.equationPreview.debounceMs.description: Delay (ms) after hover before starting an equation preview job.

context.equationPreview.rasterTool.description: PDF→image tool for equation hover. auto tries mutool, then pdftoppm, then pdftocairo.

context.equationPreview.rasterDpi.description: DPI for PNG rasterization of the equation TEXpage PDF (save PNG uses the same natural raster).

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test dist/test/**/*.test.js && npm run test:grammar
